entries.title: Kalipo request eligibility and repeat cycle
conditions: Kalipo checks weight capacity, requires the Ring of the Ancient Wise King (item 2782) to be equipped, requires ep13_3_invite to be at least 6, and requires Base Level 100 or higher.

A player can hold only one active Kalipo request record at a time. While quest record 12160 is active, Kalipo will not offer another request; the player must report the current request to the Hunting Dept. 2 Manager.

Quest record 12160 has a configured 82,800 second time limit (23 hours). After it expires, the player must speak with the Hunting Dept. 2 Manager, who clears any remaining request records, then return to Kalipo.
Kalipo selects among six requests with a Base-Level-dependent random value and threshold branches; the six offers are not equal-probability choices.

required_source_literals: Name: "Ring of the Ancient Wise King"

entries.title: Passing Grades turn-in and item reward
entries.review_method: Traced the Tutorial Goal NPC declaration, the quest-progress branch, the inventory-weight gate, quest completion, and all subsequent item grants; cross-checked each item and amount against the indexed nearby-grant record.
conditions: The Tutorial Goal NPC at moc_para01 (32,179) enters this branch only while quest 4166 is in progress (questprogress(4166) == 1).
Before dialogue, the NPC requires enough inventory capacity for a checkweight test of seven Yggdrasil Seeds; when the check fails it stops and asks the player to make room.
After the dialogue, the script completes quest 4166 and grants the listed items. No repeat reward branch is present; the completed-quest branch contains dialogue only.

entries.title: Guarana quest candy turn-in reward
entries.review_method: Traced Candy Maker state 10 branch through Guarana Fruit validation/removal, quest completion, candy grant, and EXP award; checked the separate state 11 branch to avoid conflating the quest reward with later purchases.
conditions: This reviewed turn-in branch runs when the Candy Maker script variable brazil_gua equals 10 and the player has at least one Guarana Fruit; the NPC consumes one fruit.

The NPC declaration applies an inventory check before dialogue. On success, the branch changes brazil_gua to 11, completes quest 2200, grants one Guarana Candy, and awards 70,000 base EXP plus 10,000 job EXP.
The steps that bring a player to state 10 are not reviewed here. At state 11, the script also offers a separate candy purchase for 4,000 zeny; that is distinct from this quest reward.

verified_item_rewards.explanation: Granted after the script consumes one Guarana Fruit and completes quest 2200.

entries.title: Jaty Crown finale turn-in rewards
entries.review_method: Traced Tribal Chief Paiko's stage-16 finale branch through its weight gate, stage update, item grants, quest completion, and record erase; cross-checked both item grant candidates and item database records.
conditions: Tribal Chief Paiko runs this reward branch only when the character script variable dew_legend equals 16, after the final Satay delivery stage.
If checkweight(Jaty_C,1) fails, the NPC stops without advancing the stage or granting rewards; return after freeing capacity.

On success, the script sets dew_legend to 17, grants one Jaty Crown and five Satay, then completes and erases quest record 9165. The earlier Jaty Crown and delivery prerequisites are not reviewed here.

verified_item_rewards.explanation: Granted after the stage-16 finale passes the Jaty Crown inventory check.
Five Satay are granted with the Jaty Crown reward.
